text:
BIG-IP LTM v9.2.2
Commands Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 9.2.2
RTSP::collect
- Collects the amount of
data that you specify.
RTSP::payload
- Queries for or replaces
content information.
RTSP::release
- Releases the collected
data.
Events Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 9.2.2
DNS_REQUEST
- Triggered when the system
receives a DNS request.
DNS_RESPONSE
- Triggered when the system
responds to a DNS request.
RTSP_REQUEST_DATA
- Triggered
whenever an
RTSP::collect
command
finishes processing.
RTSP_RESPONSE_DATA
- Triggered when
collection of response data is finished.
